_doc: ruby_maps: Ruby's Cave of Origin B4F (pokeruby CaveOfOrigin_B4F OnTransition: setmaplayoutindex 313 = LAYOUT_UNKNOWN_MAP_082FF894 in Ruby, 163 in Sapphire). 43 blocks differ, no collision or elevation: Kyogre's water pool (0x14e/0x14f) is Groudon's lava pool (0x35f/0x364, behaviours 0x00/0x08) and the blue crystals are red (wall art the cave builder doesn't draw). Same pool as the Sapphire recipe, drawn with Black 2's Reversal Mountain lava (set 388, chunks 723/726: in81_magu00 molten base, in81_magu01 crust 64 units per repeat, in81_mizuga1 bank). Installed in Ruby for CaveOfOrigin_B4F (data/versions.json room_variants).
